item.title: Centre warns pharma firms against advertising GLP-1 weight-loss drugs
item.description: India’s drug regulator has cautioned pharmaceutical companies against advertising GLP-1 weight-loss drugs to the public, warning that both direct and surrogate promotions could invite regulatory action. The advisory, issued by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), reiterates that prescription medicines cannot be promoted directly to consumers under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and related rules. item.title: Could cinema advertising take a programmatic turn?
item.description: For decades, cinema advertising has functioned on a model that felt insulated from the rest of the video ecosystem. Spots are pre-booked. Packages are manually negotiated. Measurement began and ended with occupancy and playouts. In an industry where video budgets now flow through DSPs (Demand Side Platforms) across CTV, online video and digital out-of-home, cinema has largely remained outside the pipes. item.title: Meta introduces AI listing, auto-replies to Facebook Marketplace
item.description: Meta has introduced new AI-powered features for Facebook Marketplace to simplify how users list items for sale and respond to buyers. More than 3.5 million listings are posted daily on Facebook Marketplace in the United States and Canada. The platform is widely used by individuals buying and selling items such as home décor, clothing and electronics. item.title: Google Maps rolls out AI-powered ‘Ask Maps’ feature
item.description: Google has introduced new AI features in Google Maps, including a conversational tool called ‘Ask Maps’ and a redesigned navigation system aimed at improving search and driving guidance. item.title: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen to step down after 18 years
item.description: Adobe's Chief Executive Officer, Shantanu Narayen, plans to step down from his role after a successor is appointed, ending an 18-year tenure leading the software company. item.title: MiQ launches AI platform for advertisers to unify campaign data & insights
item.description: MiQ on Friday launched its AI-powered platform, MiQ Sigma, in India, aimed at supporting advertisers operating across multiple media platforms.
